meta.name: CCNL Carta e Cartone — Aziende Industriali (Assocarta)

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: base_salary is the stipendio of Art. 49, TEM + EMC (Elemento di Modernizzazione Contrattuale, EUR 20.00 at C1, parametrised). 2024-07-01: column 'Minimi dal 1.7.2024' of the ipotesi of 28/07/2021 (CNEL G022, deposit 138131, p. 46), which already includes the EMC. 2026-04-01 to 2028-09-01: previous minimo + the C1 increments of the ipotesi of 10/02/2026 (CNEL deposit 246200, p. 8: 125, 45, 45, 60) reparametrised by level parameter / 153 (Art. 48 table, p. 3). The 2026 ipotesi neither abolishes nor conglobates the EMC (Art. 100 bis) and keeps Art. 49 in force, so the EMC stays in base_salary; fixed_allowances=[] for all levels.

FUTURE TRANCHES: +45 EUR at C1 from 01.01.2027, +45 from 01.01.2028, +60 from 01.09.2028 confirmed from rinnovo 10.02.2026 (zetaservice PDF). Per-level amounts are parametrically derived: each level increment = C1_increment × (level_2026-04-01 / C1_2026-04-01), rounded to cent. Math-verified all 13 levels × 3 tranches: all within ±0.02 EUR of parametric formula — consistent with the conglobated coefficient scale of the 2026 rinnovo.

EMC CHECK: aggregators and a payroll firm print 2026 minimi without the EMC (C1 1960.11 = 1835.11 + 125), but none cites a clause removing it; the signed 2026 ipotesi keeps Art. 100 bis and Art. 49. The Assocarta 'nota illustrativa e tabella nuovi minimi' of 24/02/2026 is members-only and was not read: if it shows the EMC absorbed, the 2026-2028 values are EUR 13-33 too high.

limitation.remediation: Read the Assocarta nota illustrativa of 24/02/2026 (or a signed table) and settle whether the EMC is in the 2026-2028 minimi; correct base_salary if absorbed.

notes.text: HOURLY DIVISOR: 173 (40h/week, Art. Orario di Lavoro CCNL 28/07/2021; confirmed ilccnl.it).
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Source: CCNL 28/07/2021 Art. Tredicesima mensilità. Quattordicesima not provided.
SENIORITY: biennale (24 months), max 5 scatti. Per-level amounts from CCNL 28/07/2021 Art. Aumenti periodici di anzianità (pisacaneboxes.com PDF, verified). Amounts unchanged in rinnovo 10/02/2026.

APPRENTICESHIP professionalizzante, percentage type (CCNL 28/07/2021 Art. Apprendistato professionalizzante, pisacaneboxes.com PDF): track 'triennale' (36 months, 6 semesters 70/75/80/85/90/95%) for destination levels C3, C2, C1, C1S, B2, B2S, B1, A; track 'biennale_categoria_D' (24 months, 6 quadrimestri with the same percentages) for D2 and D1. E, AS and Q are not apprenticeship destinations. The final 95% period is open-ended: after the contractual duration the worker is qualified and paid at 100% as a permanent employee.
INPS: reuses 2026-industria.json (Confindustria/CIGO). Assocarta is a Confindustria federation; CIGO applicable per D.Lgs. 148/2015.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The minimi di stipendio (TEM + Elemento di Modernizzazione Contrattuale) of the 13 levels: the 1 July 2024 tranche against the table of the ipotesi of 28 July 2021, and the four tranches of the ipotesi of 10 February 2026 (1/4/2026, 1/1/2027, 1/1/2028, 1/9/2028) derived from its C1 increments and parameter scale; both texts as deposited at CNEL.
findings: The four tranches of the 2026 renewal (52 periods) are corrected upward by the level's EMC: the file built them on the TEM-only minimo (C1 1835.11 + 125 = 1960.11), dropping the Elemento di Modernizzazione Contrattuale of EUR 20 at C1 (EUR 32.68 at Q, 13.07 at E) that the file's own 2024-07-01 value includes. The signed ipotesi of 10 February 2026 (CNEL 246200, 8-page scan read on the page images) neither abolishes nor conglobates the EMC (Art. 100 bis) and does not amend Art. 49, which defines the stipendio contrattuale as TEM + EMC; it only adds increments 'parametrati su livello C1' of 125 (aprile 2026), 45 (gennaio 2027), 45 (gennaio 2028) and 60 (settembre 2028), p. 8. The signatories' unitary communiqué of 10 February 2026 gives an overall increase of 14,8% (EUR 291 package, 275 on the minimi); ADAPT's analysis (not a signatory) gives +275 = 14,82% on the previous minimo, which is 275 / 1855.11 (with the EMC), not 275 / 1835.11 (14,99%). The values are derived as previous minimo + increment x parameter / 153, with the parameters of the Art. 48 table on p. 3 (Q 250 ... C1 153 ... E 100, the same scale as the 2021 table). On 1/4/2026 the difference from the file equals the level's EMC (e.g. C1 1960.11 -> 1980.11, Q 2882.91 -> 2915.59, B2S +23.82 against an EMC of 23.80 because of a 2-cent rounding in the file's TEM base); on the later dates it also includes the reparametrisation error below. C1 differs by exactly 20.00 on all four dates.

The future tranches of the file (1/1/2027, 1/1/2028, 1/9/2028) were also reparametrised on the ratio of the 2026 minimi (level / C1) instead of the contractual parameter scale (level / 153): e.g. Q +66.19 instead of 45 x 250/153 = 73.53 on 1/1/2027, E +33.44 instead of 29.41; the error grows with the distance from C1 and reaches -0.37 net at E on 1/9/2028 after the EMC offset. The derivation uses the parameter scale the ipotesi refers to.

Ipotesi 28 luglio 2021 (CNEL 138131, p. 46, table image): the 'Minimi dal 1.7.2024' column (TEM + EMC cumulated) matches 12 of the 13 file values; C1S is 1.924,37 against 1924.38 in the file and is corrected.

The coverage note of the file (EMC 'absorbed' into the 2026 paga base, net +105 at C1) is not supported by the signed text and will contradict the corrected values: the maintainer must rewrite it (base_salary = TEM + EMC throughout).
The ruleset now names the CNEL deposit of the text signed by Assocarta, Assografici, SLC-CGIL, Fistel-CISL, Uilcom-UIL and UGL carta e stampa: source_type contracting_party.

location.section: Contribuzione SETTORE CARTARIO-CARTOTECNICO
location.quote: Lavoratori occupati dopo il 28.04.1993: Quota TFR 100%, Contributo Lavoratore (1) 1%, Datore di lavoro (2) 1,5% (5) [...] (1) Misura minima del contributo da parte del lavoratore per avere diritto al contributo del datore di lavoro [...] (5) Percentuale in vigore dal 1.1.2023 sulla normale retribuzione annua comprensiva di 13ma mensilità

provenance.transformation: Employer 1.5% of the normale retribuzione annua from 1.1.2023, still in force on the Scheda of 25/09/2026. The normale retribuzione annua comprensiva di 13ma is the stipendio or salario contrattuale, the scatti and, where due, the indennita of ciclo continuo and turni: the pay chain of this CCNL (minimum and scatti, no allowance) on each monthly run and on the tredicesima, the TFR base of the engine on this CCNL, which holds the pay chain, the extra months and the deductions of unpaid absences, not overtime, bonuses or other events (policy it.json: only ordinary earnings, absence deductions, extra months and leave settlements enter it).
